KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.NoItem.2: No? Oh - not a bother. You have so much to do, being an adventurer and all.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.NoItem.3: I'll just sit here and slowly erode into nothingness.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Gauntlet.Done.1: OH NO YOU DIDN'T! Calm as you like, you just sauntered over to the pedestals, touched them, and came back to me! Legend. Absolute legend.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.EnterCave.2: He was accepted by the KotHaar, but on one condition: his core must be forged into a new body. And that body is controlled by Fuzan.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Gauntlet.Done.3: Right, I think I've learned enough from you. I'm ready to be accepted by my people. I'm going to the Cave of Screams, to the west behind the sunken pyramid.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.Return.QuestComplete.1: Unless you wish to be forged into a KotHaar, which is likely impossible, there is nothing more for you here.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Gauntlet.NotDone.1: Oh, I must admit I thought you would be completing THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Gauntlet.NotDone.2: If you don't have time, that's fine, obviously. But if you do have time, then four thumbs up.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Gauntlet.NotDone.3: Go out there on your magic carpet, find four pedestals that look like giant black blocks, and tag them before coming back.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.NoEntry.1: Halt! This place is not for your eyes. Turn back.
KeysToEntries.Objective.2: Touch 4 pedestals in any order in THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE - 0/4
KeysToEntries.Objective.5: Use the KotHaar numbering book to get past the KotHaar Bouncer
KeysToEntries.Zi.Intro.Post.Choice.No.1: Of course! You are busy! Very busy! I will wait here and die and become one with the desert.
KeysToEntries.Player.NotEnter.Cave.1: You step away from the door.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Gauntlet.Done.4: Come see how I do! There's a KotHaar Bouncer there, guarding the entrance. He will ask for a password.
KeysToEntries.Pedestal.Dec.NotStarted.1: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?
KeysToEntries.Zi.Gauntlet.Done.5: It is SO simple. Count the total number of words that he says to you. The total number IS the password. See you in there! I'M GOING TO BE A REAL KOTHAAR!
KeysToEntries.Objective.4: Use the password to enter the Cave of Screams, within the Burning Spire region
KeysToEntries.Objective.3: Return to Zi in the Burning Spire region of the Umbral Sands
KeysToEntries.Zi.Intro.2: I thought humans would shrivel up in the Scorch, but LOOK at you. The name is KotHaar-Hok-Zi, but you can call me Zi. And, unlike you, I...I'm not as well suited to the Scorch.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Intro.1: Oh my, OH MY, it's a human! Look at how long and weird-looking you are! You're like half a spider.
KeysToEntries.Objective.6: Return to the KotHaar Bouncer outside of the Cave of Screams
KeysToEntries.Zi.Name: Zi
KeysToEntries.Pedestal.Desc.Started.1: You touch the pedestal. It activates.
KeysToEntries.Player.Enter.Cave.1: You hear screams from beyond the door. Yeah, this is the Cave of Screams alright.
KeysToEntries.Barrier.NoEntry.1: None shall pass, by command of Fuzan.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.Outro.NoSpace.1: Or, at least, I would if you had any space in your piddling human pockets. Empty some space and come back to me.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.Password.1: Halt! Speak the password to me, stranger, or you shall not pass.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.QuestStarted.1: Hello hello! Do you remember me? It's the KotHaar, Zi!
KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.HasItem.5: Meanwhile, I'm going to shout your name and periodically punch the air!
KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.HasItem.4: Out there, around the Burning Spire, are four pedestals. They're giant black blocks with fire on top - you can't miss them. You are going to touch the four pedestals in any order and then come back to me.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.HasItem.3: This is all too much. Okay, okay, next up is THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE! You're going to show me how to navigate lava and also be a kickass hero.
KeysToEntries.Objective.1: Bring 1 cactus steak and 3 raw beltfish back to Zi in Umbral Sands
KeysToEntries.Zi.Intro.Post.Choice.3: Bring me 1 cactus steak and 3 raw beltfish. Show me how to gather life from the sand like a desert witch! A sand-witch, hehe!
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.EnterCave.1: Zi is inside. But I warn you - he is changed.
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.Quest.Start.No.1: No, I don't have time for that
KeysToEntries.Zi.Intro.5: OH MY KILN I just had a brilliant idea! You can teach me how to survive in the desert!
KeysToEntries.Zi.Intro.Post.Choice.1: Thank you thank you thank you. You will NOT regret this. Okay, what do survival people do in the desert? Ah, yes, they make their own food!
KeysToEntries.Zi.Intro.4: It's why I am out here, actually. I was told that I couldn't be a real KotHaar, on account of my frailty. But it's only temporary! I am going to prove that I am definitely NOT the weak-link they say I am.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.GiveBook.1: You misunderstand, human. We do not speak numbers as you do.
KeysToEntries.Objective.2.1: Touch 4 pedestals in any order in THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE - 1/4
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.Return.QuestComplete.2: But I will say that I admire your skill, human.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.NoItem.1: Did you bring me the things that you gathered from the desert?
KeysToEntries.Quest.Desc: Help Zi to become a real KotHaar
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.Password.Arrows: Two triangles separated by a line?
KeysToEntries.Zi.Return.HasItem.1: You came back! And you brought the cactus steak and the fish belts!
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.GiveBook.2: Think like a KotHaar. Take this book and return when you can count… properly.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.GiveBook.NoSpace.1: Ugh. Humans and their tiny pockets. Come back when you have space for what I give you.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Outro.2: OH MY KILN you were amazing! I was all like 'ARGH I AM IN THE GRIP OF FUZAN!' and you were like 'I WILL SAVE YOU, ZI!'.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Outro.3: What a day, eh? Well, I guess I'm a KotHaar Core now. A tiny marble. But at least I've not being puppeted by a giant dragon, right?
KeysToEntries.Zi.Outro.1: You pick up something small, black and buzzing with energy.
KeysToEntries.Objective.2.2: Touch 4 pedestals in any order in THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE - 2/4
KeysToEntries.Objective.2.3: Touch 4 pedestals in any order in THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE - 3/4
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.PlayerForgot.Numbers.1: Human. I despair. Remember the numbering book that I gave you?
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.CorrectPassword.1: Correct, human who is clearly not a KotHaar.
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.Password.X: An X with a line through the middle?
KeysToEntries.Zi.Outro.5: Could you do me a favour and take me to the Bouncer outside of the cave? I've got a bit of house-keeping to do.
KeysToEntries.Zi.Core.Name: Zi's Core
KeysToEntries.Zi.Outro.NoSpace.1: Um, could you make some room for me to hop in your pockets? It's crowded in there.
KeysToEntries.Outro.1: I see you have reversed the forging process, KotHaar-Hok-Zi.
KeysToEntries.Outro.2: I did, with help from the adventurer. Um, after some consideration, I have decided that I am not going to be a KotHaar after all.
KeysToEntries.Outro.3: The Bouncer looks from side to side, as if checking if someone is watching.
KeysToEntries.Outro.4: Good for you, little one. Grab this opportunity with all four hands. I wish I had done the same.
KeysToEntries.Outro.5: And you, human - you have been a friend to this little KotHaar. I wish to give you a trophy from Zi's discarded body.
KeysToEntries.Outro.NoItem.1: Or, at least, I would if you had any space in your piddling human pockets. Empty some space and come back to me.
KeysToEntries.KotHaar.Numbering.Book.Desc: A book for understanding the KotHaar numbering system (Base 12).
KeysToEntries.Zi.Core.Desc: Look, adventurer, I have an item description!
KeysToEntries.ReforgedZi.Name: Reforged Zi
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.NotReadBook: It would serve you well, human, to read the guide I gave you.
KeysToEntries.Bouncer.BookSnark: And you answered that without even reading the leaflet I gave you. Almost as if you were guided to the answer by some invisible force.
KeysToEntries.Pedestal.Name: Pedestal
